0|7dfbc624eb5726367900c8d86deff50836240361|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"KVM: nVMX: Query current VMCS when determining if MSR bitmaps are in use
Check the current VMCS controls to determine if an MSR write will be
intercepted due to MSR bitmaps being disabled.  In the nested VMX case
KVM will disable MSR bitmaps in vmcs02 if they're disabled in vmcs12 or
if KVM can't map L1's bitmaps for whatever reason.
Note
column2: the bad behavior is relatively benign in the current code base as

column1: KVM sets all bits in vmcs02's MSR bitmap by default
only if L0 KVM also disables interception of an MSR
buggy helper for MSR_IA32_SPEC_CTRL.  Because KVM explicitly tests WRMSR
before disabling interception of MSR_IA32_SPEC_CTRL
will only result in KVM reading MSR_IA32_SPEC_CTRL from hardware when it
isn't strictly necessary.
Tag the fix for stable in case a future fix wants to use
msr_write_intercepted()
column2: in which case a buggy implementation in older

column1: kernels could prove subtly problematic.
Fixes: d28b387fb74d (""KVM/VMX: Allow direct access to MSR_IA32_SPEC_CTRL"")
